notes.title: What two last patches does
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with unable to load the last level
[*]Sound settings are now saves properly after quiting to main menu
[*]Difficulty settings removed 
[*]You can now request hint for a puzzle whenever you want by pressing H once per puzzle
[*]Minor improvements to hint pictures
[*]Achievements for completing the game on different difficulty levels removed
[/list]

notes.title: 9 month update
notes.content:
Greetings, Friends!

How do you feel at self-isolation? We hope that you doing great.
It's been nine month since we realesead our first game. And we knew it was far from perfect. But some events prevented us from bringing it to this state. But today we happy to inform you that we have overcome all the obstacles and finally we can present you the game in the state it meant to be released back then.

Here are the changes we've made:
[list]
[*]Bug with black screen in the final cutscene removed. You can finally see what happen there. Sorry for a long wait.
[*]Video settings removed from setting menu in order to avoid conflicts with the settings in Unity launcher.
[*]'Crosshair' added to the game to help you point to pictures and to the button. You can toggle it in game settings.
[*]Ligthing settings reworked to make the room look more realistic.
[*]4 new achievements added.
[*]Picture hints reworked to be more helpful and clear.
[*]Wonderful music track by Scott Buckley added to the final level to make it feels more emotional.
[*]One more portrait of one of the US presidents added to 39 level to make it more challenging.
[*]Text hints at the lower right corner of the screen replaced with fancy interactive picture hint.
[*]And finally! Cool, real, beautiful and shining model of a button made by our new cool 3D artist. It replaced the old one that was made by the programmer:) Sound was added too. It's so nicely to press it now!
[/list]
